cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Try one grape from the middle of the bunch. The ripest-looking one won't tell us whether the rest are sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One representative sample. You taste it; I'll compare mine afterwards if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you hold the bunch where the assistant can see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Twist one grape off; don't pull at the whole bunch. You taste first, then I'll have something to compare.

reason: Replace vague dont-tear-it correction with a specific handling instruction while preserving A visible holding and B first forbidden taste.
